title: Do not send the `state` argument before the `helper` argument
body:
Current widget API is:

```js
init(state, helper);
render(results, state, helper);
```

I see us never using the `state` param for now, and it is accessible through helper.state.

I am not sure it will be easy to understand and we do not advocate using the `helper.state` token in the helper docs either.

So I propose to either:

* remove entirely the state argument from our widget API function signatures
* always put it last in function signatures

What do you think?
